title: Xdrip+ Contour Next One not syncing
body: Using Xdrip+ build  14fecb8-2019.01.10 and have connected a Contour Next One to the system through Bluetooth. It shows it is connected and I can do a manual sync of all the BG test but any new BG test does not automatically add to xdrip. I have tried removing the Contour and I have even uninstalled xdrip as well. I have tried looking through the logs and nothing during that time stamp show anything. This worked on my old phone but my new phone doesn't. The phone is a LG K30 using 8.1.0 android.
